caveat: screen/advisory only, NOT tradeable (Cycle2). IC sign-flip across regimes is the selector premise; magnitude-only variation is already captured by regime-beta overlays and does not qualify. If GO, canonical step must re-test under long-only top20 production constraints.

data_sufficiency_caveat.issue: Crisis state collapsed to n=1 month after IC overlap (regime_v7 Crisis months mostly predate 2005 IC coverage or fall in months without IC). Effective test is 2-state: Normal(201) vs Transition_LR(25).
data_sufficiency_caveat.implication: The most selector-relevant regime (Crisis) is underpowered. NO-GO rests on no sign-flip between Normal and Transition_LR. A canonical follow-up wanting to rescue the idea would need a Crisis-rich IC window (pre-2005 IC unavailable) or a finer regime with more crisis mass.
data_sufficiency_caveat.secondary_finding: 2 families (risk, crowding) show significantly NEGATIVE conditional IC in at least one state (their raw signals invert), and 7 families significantly positive; but NO family is both +sig and -sig, so 0 sign-divergent.
